summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing prefetch optimization for content loading before user interaction. It differs semantically from existing skills: 'Link Component Prefetching' is framework-specific (Next.js) and navigation-focused; 'Future Completion Callback Registration' is unrelated (Flink async task completion). Peer candidates address orthogonal concerns (offscreen insertion, live CLS monitoring, Performance Observer). The candidate has valid support evidence and no conflicts. It should be created as a new capability in the content_loading task family.
